notes:
REC button on the telemetry overlay.

- Start and stop the recording from the overlay's title bar, next to the gear, without going back to GOAT.
- It shows the same truth as the Highlights panel: red with a running clock whenever a recording is open, whoever started it (Auto mode included); amber while OBS is coming up or while a recording is armed for the moment you are on track; grey when idle.
- Stopping here stops it everywhere, and the highlight moments are logged exactly as when you press Start on the web page.
